description.narrative: This project provides sustained technical assistance to member countries, for example building capacity to implement policies and laws. This support will build on previous work to reach agreements on maritime boundaries and ocean policy development by continual support to guide national and regional ocean development. Where the Secretariat has supported the negotiation of international treaties it will continue to provide technical assistance to inform domestic legislation and policy to leverage the opportunities afforded by the treaties. The project will also provide capacity building of government officials through knowledge exchanges and online training modules.??
